text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by the school gate—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, ref spotted!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The "time" has come
to make your judgment roar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"There you go saying
things that make no sense again..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So with that, let's freakin' gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having been dragged out of the blue to a karaoke box—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I ended up having to act as the referee
for their "Endless Singing Battle."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All riiight, you ready, Mac-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoever runs out of steam first loses!
Welcome to the first circle of hell, babyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No matter what form it takes, you've got nerve challenging me to a contest of stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Your self-centered behavior has been glaringly out of line for quite some time now..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is time I delivered the finishing blow to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Normally, she seemed to take Gold Ship's bizarre antics with broad-minded patience, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did you notice too?
Yeah, this guy, I swear...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Enough of this pointless chatter!
We are starting now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so the karaoke battle began, but Mejiro
McQueen gradually pulled ahead thanks to having
some of the highest stamina in the academy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... *cough*.
Ughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, huff... Oh my, are you finished already?
You really are all talk, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn it. Not only do they have the bottomless stamina honed from races,
but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Belting out cheer songs for an average of 3 hours...
Your vocal cord endurance is out of this world...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Talking about watching baseball
has nothing to do with this right now, does it?!
Besides... I'm not going anyway!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Dammit, what am I supposed to do...?
At this rate, I'm gonna...!!"
choice_data_list: Remember those days of grueling training!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Dammit, what am I supposed to do...?
At this rate, I'm gonna...!!"
choice_data_list: Remember those days of grueling training!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hah... That's it, the drink bar!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No sooner had she said it than Gold Ship dashed out of the room. And then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Comin' right up!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!? W-Wh-Wh-What on earth is that
bubbling liquid with such an indescribable color...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, drink up, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, of courrrse I am, dammit!!
Hurry up and open your mouth, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gurgle, gurgle, gurgle...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...ner, Trainer!
Oh, thank goodness, you've regained consciousness...!"
choice_data_list: W-What on earth is going on...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's enough!!
...That's enough.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The battle is over.
You taught me that with your own two feet.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The futility of conflict...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't quite get it, but the karaoke battle
ended with 'a draw (after learning the futility of fighting)'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't recall giving any training like that,
but knowing Gold Ship...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's how it was, wasn't it?
Man, what is wrong with me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"How could you forget those days when we trained our diaphragmatic breathing with a dragon on our bellies,
singing non-stop from moonrise to moonset?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I'm wide awake now!!
From here on out is the real me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...So you claim you still will not surrender?
I shall at least give you credit for your sheer persistence!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold Ship and the others sang their hearts out
until they all ran completely out of energy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result ended up being
a refreshingly clean draw.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*Cough, cough*... It's no use.
I don't feel like I can sing another note...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You take the grand finale. The song is, of course...
The 'Tracers Academy Anthem'...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, on the way back—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sniff, sniff... Whoa there, ain't that a
seriously good smell wafting over here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I call roasted sweet potatoes!!
Let's grab a bite, McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Roasted sweet potatoes, you say?
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...No. I have sung plenty, after all.
If it is only half a sweet potato, I will gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Alright then... Trainer, hand over your wallet!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship and the others
split the piping-hot roasted sweet potatoes and ate them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh...!
Sweets after so long truly hit the spot...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look at you, Mac-chan~
Rockin' such a pretty, smiley face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh... P-Please do not tease me so!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good grief. ...What a strange person, truly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched warmly as Mejiro McQueen's mood
softened, standing beside a thoroughly satisfied Gold Ship—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Mind if I keep living large on your wallet?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It was quite an ordeal getting my wallet back.
